model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of the disclosed coupling, emphasizing the oil-pump and pressure-relief implementation. Alternate clutch embodiments are noted but not represented as co-installed.

subsystems.description: External driving machine supplying rotary input through the input half coupling.

subsystems.subsystem_name: Input half coupling and annular gear
subsystems.description: Receives input rotation and torque and drives the epicyclic gear train through its input annular gear.
Intermediate planet gearing meshes with input and output annular gears and drives the pump gears carried by its carrier.

subsystems.subsystem_name: Output annular gear and half coupling
subsystems.description: Receives transmission through the output annular gear and delivers rotary power to the driven machine.

Carrier-mounted gear pump assembly: the carrier houses a corresponding number of gear pumps, each formed by a pair of gears driven by a planet gear, and has a central chamber receiving their pumped oil. Claim 3 states that below the pressure-relief-valve-determined chamber pressure, the gear pump and consequently gear train are locked; it does not assign a separate locking cause to the pump or chamber.

parts.description: Carrier housing the planet gears and a corresponding number of gear pumps; it has a central chamber receiving pump-delivered oil.
Pair of gears in each gear pump, driven by its corresponding planet gear.

subsystems.description: Receives oil delivered by the gear pump and is closed by a pressure relief valve; the valve-determined pressure threshold governs the stated pump and gear-train locked/unlocked behavior.
Opens at the predetermined chamber pressure, allowing pump rotation and consequent relative rotation in the gear train.
External driven machinery receiving rotary output from the output half coupling.

item_flows.name: Epicyclic gear transmission
item_flows.notes: Rotary transmission among annular and planet gears.

item_flows.name: Pump drive rotation
item_flows.notes: Intermediate gearing drives carrier-mounted pump gears.

item_flows.name: Pumped oil
item_flows.notes: Gear pumps deliver oil to the chamber.

item_flows.name: Relief flow
item_flows.notes: Oil passes the relief valve when it opens.

requirements.statement: Below a predetermined input torque, retain the gear train to provide a 1:1 input/output ratio.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1 supplies the below-threshold 1:1 behavior; this model allocates it to the selected hydraulic embodiment of dependent claim 3 (which depends through claim 2). The specific pump/chamber implementation is not asserted as a limitation of claim 1 alone.

requirements.statement: At or above the predetermined torque threshold, permit relative rotation between input and output gears to limit transmitted torque.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1 supports the general release and relative-rotation behavior; in this selected dependent claim-3 embodiment (depending through claim 2), opening of the pressure relief valve allows the pump and hence gear train to rotate, permitting relative rotation. The embodiment-specific hydraulic implementation is not asserted as a limitation of claim 1 alone.

steps.description: Input annular gear drives the epicyclic gear train and output annular gear.

Below the pressure-relief-valve-determined chamber pressure, the gear pump and consequently the gear train are locked, supporting 1:1 input/output rotation; no additional physical cause of the lock is asserted.
Gear pumps pressurize the chamber as driven by the intermediate gearing.
At the predetermined pressure the relief valve opens.
The pump and gear train can rotate, permitting relative rotation between the input and output gears.
